scenarios.title: Domestic retail purchase at POS, contact chip
scenarios.notes: Domestic POS chip fields are present; applied controls/limits and accounting hold effects are not retained as transaction history.

scenarios.title: Domestic contactless below the CVM limit
scenarios.notes: Eight domestic contactless purchase candidates exist, shared with W28. Historical CVM thresholds and PIN/CVM evidence are absent, so none can be assigned specifically to below-CVM.

scenarios.title: Domestic contactless above the CVM limit
scenarios.notes: The same eight contactless purchase candidates apply. Stored PIN blocks and CVM results are absent; this does not prove that PIN was absent on the original request. Above-CVM/PIN verification cannot be assigned.

scenarios.title: Domestic e-commerce, card not present
scenarios.notes: No retained record matches the ECOMMERCE fields in the available Switch rules. DE22=801 is PURCHASE_FALLBACK, not e-commerce. Missing legacy fields mean absence of a match does not prove no e-commerce test was ever run.

scenarios.title: Domestic ATM cash withdrawal with online PIN
scenarios.notes: Requires processing code 010000, ATM01 channel tag, acquiring country356 and MCC6011. Online PIN verification, the historical applied limit and accounting debit/hold effects are not proved.

scenarios.title: International POS and international e-commerce
scenarios.notes: International POS component only. No identifiable international e-commerce record; the combined scenario is not complete.

scenarios.title: Refund or credit to the card
scenarios.notes: Refund processing code 200000 is retained in 47 request records, all sharing RRN 516015123456 across 31 distinct composite request keys. None has an exact saved-response match. These are not 47 distinct certification test cases. Credit accounting direction and balance effects are unverified. Money-load codes 28/29 are separately reported, not silently counted as refunds.

scenarios.title: Balance enquiry
scenarios.notes: Balance-enquiry processing code310000 is retained. Returned balances and accounting equality/no-hold requirements are not established by this count.

scenarios.title: Decline cases
scenarios.notes: 113 linked response 55 wrong-PIN records and two linked response 61 limit records. These include different transaction types, including 18 failed PIN-change requests. Seven more response 61 rows have no exact request-key match. Generic 05 cannot identify wrong CVV; codes 58/62 do not prove a CMS channel-disable or hot-list test. No expired/lost/stolen-specific responses were found.

scenarios.title: Pre-authorisation creates a hold
scenarios.notes: One older approved INR 75 pre-authorisation, RRN 609812914133, on 8 April 2026. Accounting hold creation is unverified.

scenarios.title: Cancellation releases the pre-authorisation hold
scenarios.notes: One cancellation request links exactly by DE90 and anonymous card identity to the approved INR 75 pre-authorisation. Reversal response 96 is a failure; release of the hold was not demonstrated.

scenarios.title: Timely final presentment settles the authorised transaction
scenarios.notes: Switch history does not establish clearing presentment timing, posting, hold consumption or release. No case counted.

scenarios.title: Full authorisation reversal
scenarios.notes: Positive full-amount reversals linked by DE90+card identity to approved original debit authorisations. Includes one W37 pre-authorisation cancellation. Saved reversal codes and original codes are retained; accounting release is unverified.

scenarios.title: Partial reversal
scenarios.notes: All127 uniquely linked older reversals repeat the original amount. No positive reversal amount lower than the original and no DE95 replacement amount was found.

scenarios.title: Timeout reversal
scenarios.notes: Generic reversal records exist, but timeout reason and duplicate-release behaviour are not retained. No request can be identified confidently as this exact timeout scenario.

scenarios.title: Authorisation completion or advice
scenarios.notes: No0120/0220 completion/advice request or retained completion function/condition evidence found.

scenarios.title: Hold expiry with no clearing
scenarios.notes: Hold expiry belongs to accounting under the reference. It cannot be established from the inspected Switch history.

method: Exclude the eight exact primary/helper row IDs from the latest supplied run; retain all other legacy request rows, including undated records, explicitly flagged.
Request record counts are not unique certification test cases:71 records repeat a composite request key. No authoritative certification case ID is stored.
Saved responses join on exact MTI+DE7+RRN composite ISO transaction identifier. Numeric register IDs belong to a different identifier family.
Reversal links use DE90 from the primary request OR saved response, match original MTI/STAN/transmission date-time and anonymous same-card group, and require exactly one original.
Current available RuPay rule definitions from the local falcon-switch-core1.0.58 image interpret retained ISO fields; this is not a claim that every historical version derived the same type.
Only response codes55 and61 are counted as specific W35 signals. Other codes are retained separately and not forced into unsupported reasons.
Counts establish historical transaction evidence only; none proves all document requirements, controls, CVM/PIN checks, accounting holds, balances, settlement or expiry.
W01-W25 are CMS setup/lifecycle workflows and are outside a payment-history count. Network PIN-change history related to W16 is reported separately.
